latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Analyze financial reports in PDF format, extract key metrics, and generate visual and textual analysis.

- Automatically parses China A-share, Hong Kong, and US-listed company PDFs to extract financial data.
- Calculates and summarizes profitability, growth, solvency, and operating indicators.
- Supports multi-period comparisons and trend analyses of key financial metrics.
- Generates visual charts (trends, structures, comparisons) and Markdown-format analysis reports.
- All data processed locally for enhanced privacy; no data upload or external API use.
- Optimized for standard mainland China financial report formats.
